entities.summary: Charles Bradford Cooper II is an American admiral who has served as the commander of the United States Central Command since 2025. He most recently served as its deputy commander from 2024 to 2025, and before that was commander of the U.S. Naval Forces Central Command, U.S. Fifth Fleet, and Combined Maritime Forces from 2021 to 2024. He has led U.S. forces in combat operations during the Red Sea crisis and the 2026 Iran war.
